site_and_browser_access.lock_behavior: Source-only adapter requires the upstream acquireBrowserOperationLock('tab-api') provider; it is acquired after verifying an already connected dedicated browser, and released after the full read. The future Windows runner creates/removes temporary tab-api.lock in upstream browser-control directory. In this chat no Windows host was accessed and no real lockfile was created on the user's machine. This only serializes cooperative upstream code; manual or third-party browser activity can still race.
site_and_browser_access.observation_timeout: READ_ONLY_OBSERVATION_TIMEOUT; result discarded and upstream tab-api release attempted; on release error return UPSTREAM_OPERATION_LOCK_RELEASE_FAILED
site_and_browser_access.pending_timeout_reads: Promise.race bounds result, but an already pending Playwright page.evaluate may still settle later if the adapter is reused in a long-running host. Current intended use remains a one-shot CLI process, which exits after writing the redacted receipt; real Windows process lifecycle not yet validated.

remote_public_video_probe.notes: Both requests failed with per-URL timeout; search-index text is not a live page verification. Further automatic retries stopped.

site_and_browser_access.original_bridge_get_binding: Original get.js unmodified; wrapper preflights exact one alive registered target and wraps original get expression in a browser-context live location.href gate. Registered URLs can be stale on SPA navigation; live guard rejects incorrect current routes.
site_and_browser_access.original_bridge_token_setup_blocker: Original userscript CONFIG.token is blank in the MIT snapshot; server may generate its own runtime token at startup. Matching server/userscript/runner local token required for actual site handshake. Do not upload or ask for token; no real user device accessed.

next_acceptance: Portable ZIP (two core Node scripts, safe interactive input, root CMD launcher, README and SHA256SUMS) now supports a one-off owner-validated CDP read of up to 12 currently visible comments in an existing project-owned Windows Edge tab. 32/32 combined local tests pass and all GitHub file hashes match; no chat-accessible Douyin browser tab and no Windows local CDP capability in this chat. Only a real host-side run and returned receipt can prove live Douyin reading. No paid Windows Actions, main merge, EXE change or upstream broad userscript installation.
